name: Pneuma
description:
About This Game

THE AWARD NOMINATED GAME Pneuma is a single-player hack-and-slash adventure where you step into the role of Zoe, Deaths Apprentice stripped of her soul and left to fight for the pieces that were stolen from her. To reclaim what’s hers, Zoe must face off against the Seven Deadly Sins, each guarded by relentless hordes of skeletons, demons, and corrupted creatures determined to stop her at every turn. Every battle pushes Zoe closer to restoring her power and closer to the truth of her destiny: to rise again as the new embodiment of Death. Fast-paced combat, brutal enemies, and intense boss encounters will test your skill, timing, and strategy as you carve a path through a world drowned in darkness and corruption.

KEY FEATURES

  • Fast-Paced Hack-and-Slash Combat

Slice through waves of enemies with fluid, responsive combat designed to feel rewarding and intense.

  • Face the Seven Deadly Sins

Each Sin serves as a unique, high-stakes boss encounter with its own mechanics, personality, and arena.

  • Hordes of Skeletons & Demons

Battle relentless enemies that force you to adapt, dodge, and choose your attacks wisely.

  • A World Consumed by Darkness

Explore corrupted city's and arenas, each themed around the Sins who rule them.

  • Grow Stronger with Every Fight

Collect the stolen fragments of Zoe’s soul to regain her power and uncover her true purpose.

  • Stylish Abilities & Combat Variety

 Unlock new moves, abilities, and strategies as you push deeper into the realm of the Sins.

STORY SYNOPSIS

Take Back What Was Stolen.

Zoe’s soul has been shattered and claimed by the Seven Deadly Sins. To reclaim it, she must defeat each Sin, survive the hordes that defend them, and rise stronger after every battle. With each fragment recovered, Zoe steps closer to reclaiming her identity, and fulfilling a destiny tied directly to Death itself.

Award Nomination
short_desc: Take the role of Zoe, Deaths apprentice, and fight back against the 7 Deadly sins who stole the fragments of your soul, engage in fast paced top-down hack and slash action, fending off hoards of Hell's spawn. Gain buffs throughout the different levels to increase your power to take on the bosses....
